use default

is_prime(value: int) -> bool =>
    value > 1 /\ ((2..value)
        |> take_while(divisor => divisor * divisor <= value)
        |> all(divisor => value % divisor != 0))

is_wieferich(prime: int) -> bool =>
    let square = bigint(prime) * bigint(prime) in
    bigint.mod_pow(2n, bigint(prime - 1), square) =~ 1n

write_line("Wieferich primes less than 5000:")

write_line((2..5000)
    |> filter(is_prime)
    |> filter(is_wieferich)
    |> join(" "))
